title: Exclusive: Doomberg Shares His Investment Strategy
speaker: Doomberg

macro_themes.view: Earn in fiat, save in real assets (gold, land), invest privately, and follow fixed rules without emotion; avoids public stocks.
Buys physical and paper gold monthly regardless of price to preserve purchasing power; would sell into a Treasury gold revaluation.
Lost Russian exports from a ~7 mb/d seaborne diesel market caused the spike; refinery flexibility and demand cuts will create a glut within ~2 years.
Europe-Russia escalation puts the world closer to nuclear exchange than the Cuban missile crisis; hopes we are near the end of the fourth turning.

calls.condition: Absent a nuclear war; may still have a blow-off top first
calls.reason: Diesel spike came from losing ~11% of the ~7 mb/d seaborne diesel market; refinery flexibility adding output plus demand destruction will create a glut, so crack spreads at 110 can't last.
calls.quote: diesel is fixing to be a pretty good short at some point soon... absent a nuclear war, you won't be able to give away diesel in 2 years

calls.reason: All shortages lead to gluts; current supply crisis will pass and leave a crude glut.
calls.quote: There's going to be a glut of diesel. It's going to be a glut of crude oil.

calls.instrument_quoted: gold (physical + paper gold in retirement account)
calls.reason: Monthly rules-based accumulation as a store of value expected to hold purchasing power over ~20 years; sold some ~5,200 and bought back after drop to ~3,900; would take profits only if gold revalued (e.g. $20,000).
calls.quote: if I wake up in two decades and check the price of gold, it'll be roughly dollar parity to what I can buy today

notes: Guest says 'math lesson to end the week' and NFL 'this weekend', so likely recorded on a Friday (~Oct 9 or 16); listing date kept. Diesel has no canonical ticker in the spec; HO (NY Harbor ULSD futures) used. Gold call is a savings DCA, not a price forecast; mentions past trades (sold ~5,200, top ~5,400, low ~3,900). 10y yield mentioned at 5.3 only as 'noise'.
